info.title: tZERO Institutional API Documents
info.description:
## Overview

The **tZERO Institutional API** — programmatic access to transfer-agent, tokenization, and custody operations for institutional issuers and partners. Production base URL `api.t0direct.com`.

### Authentication
All requests require an API key in the `X-API-Key` header. Generate keys at [app.t0kenizer.com/ta/api-keys](https://app.t0kenizer.com/ta/api-keys).

```
X-API-Key: t0k_your_api_key_here
```

### Scopes
Keys are issued with one or more scopes. A request to an endpoint whose
required scope the key lacks returns `403 FORBIDDEN`. `FULL_ACCESS` satisfies
every scope.

**Transfer Agent**
- `TA_READ` — Read investors, securities, holdings, documents, dividends, corporate actions, proposals
- `TA_WRITE` — Create/update investors, submit issuances, declare dividends and corporate actions, create voting proposals
- `TA_TRANSFERS` — Submit and manage book-entry transfers
- `TA_ADMIN` — Administrative TA operations

**Tokenization** (read-only today)
- `TOKENS_READ` — Read token configurations and deployments
- `DEPLOYMENTS_READ` — Read deployments and operation history

> The investor registry / cap table is served by the Transfer Agent **Investors** endpoints (`TA_READ` / `TA_WRITE`).

**Custody** (read-only today)
- `CUSTODY_READ` — Read vaults, balances, transfers, and whitelisted addresses

> Write scopes (`TOKENS_WRITE`, `DEPLOYMENTS_WRITE`, `PRICE_WRITE`, `CUSTODY_WRITE`, `CAPTABLE_*`) exist in the enum but are **reserved** — exposed only when those capabilities are opened to customers.

**Master**
- `FULL_ACCESS` — Satisfies all scopes (use sparingly)

### Base URL
```
https://api.t0direct.com/api/v1
```

### Pagination
List endpoints support `page` and `perPage` query parameters. Responses include a `pagination` object with `total`, `page`, `perPage`, and `totalPages`.

### Idempotency
Transfer and issuance requests support an `idempotencyKey` field. Submitting the same key twice returns the original record without creating a duplicate.

Dividend, corporate-action, and proposal mutations require an `Idempotency-Key` **header**. An exact retry replays the original response; reusing a key with a different payload returns `409 Conflict`.

### Corporate actions, dividends & voting (review-gated)
Declarations submitted through `/v1/dividends`, `/v1/corporate-actions`, and `/v1/proposals` enter `PENDING_REVIEW` — a tZERO transfer-agent reviewer approves or rejects each one under a regulatory turnaround timer (SEC Rule 17Ad-2). Approved actions execute according to the security's execution target; on-chain executions (dividend creation on the claim contract, split initialization, vote anchoring) settle via tZERO's Fireblocks custody and surface transaction hashes on the entity.

Voting proposals support per-token `votingMode`: `OFF_CHAIN` (transfer-agent register) or `ON_CHAIN` (record-block eligibility from token checkpoints, privacy-preserving ballot commitments, and Merkle-root anchors published on the token's chain). Investors vote in their own t0kenizer portal accounts — ballots cannot be submitted through this API. Track lifecycle via `ta.dividend.*`, `ta.corporate_action.*`, and `ta.proposal.*` webhook events.

### Webhooks
Subscribe to events at `POST /v1/webhooks`. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using your webhook secret.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of investors for the authenticated issuer.

post.description: Creates a new investor record for the authenticated issuer.

name.description: Investor full name or entity name

sharesOwned.description: Total shares owned — non-negative integer as string

get.description: Returns a single investor by ID for the authenticated issuer.

patch.description: Partially updates an investor record. All body fields are optional.

sharesOwned.description: Total shares owned — non-negative integer as string

get.description: Returns all security holdings for a single investor.
Returns a paginated list of securities for the authenticated issuer.
Returns a single security by ID, including the top 10 holders.
Returns paginated list of all shareholders for this security, ordered by shares descending.

parameters.name: minBalance
parameters.description: When true (default), excludes holders with a zero balance

totalShares.description: Total shares outstanding for this security

get.description: Alias for GET /:id/captable. Returns the same paginated shareholder list.

parameters.name: minBalance
parameters.description: When true (default), excludes holders with a zero balance

totalShares.description: Total shares outstanding for this security

post.description: Submits a book-entry transfer from one investor to another. The transfer is queued as PENDING until approved by a TA admin. Supports an optional `idempotencyKey` to prevent duplicate submissions.

price.description: Optional price per unit as numeric string

post.description: Submit up to 500 transfer requests in a single call. Each item supports its own `idempotencyKey`. Returns individual results per item.

patch.description: Approve or reject a PENDING transfer request. Approval executes the balance change atomically.

post.description: Queues a primary share issuance request for approval. Equivalent to Vertalo's TaRequest. The issuance is PENDING until a TA admin approves it, at which point shares are credited to the investor.

quantity.description: Number of shares as numeric string

recipientType.description: Why this issuance is being submitted — primary offering vs. employee/vendor/consultant grant, etc. Defaults to PRIMARY_OFFERING when omitted.

post.description: Approves a PENDING issuance request and executes the share credit to the investor's balance atomically.

Generates a v4-signed PUT URL bound to the per-issuer Cloud HSM key and returns a confirmation token. The URL is valid for 15 minutes; the client uploads the file directly to GCS, then calls PUT /upload/:uploadToken to finalize.

put.description: Confirms a document upload. The body is empty in Phase 2 — the API constructs the storage path internally and verifies the object exists at the expected GCS key. Idempotent.

get.description: Returns all webhook event types that can be subscribed to. No authentication required.

post.description: Creates a new webhook subscription. A secret is auto-generated if not provided. The secret is returned ONCE on creation — store it securely. Use it to verify incoming webhook signatures (HMAC-SHA256).

Queues a `ta.test` event for delivery to the subscription's URL to verify the endpoint is reachable and the signature verification logic is correct. Delivery is asynchronous (fire-and-forget) — the response confirms the event was queued, not that the remote endpoint accepted it.

post.summary: Create reversal of an executed settlement

put.summary: Upsert settlement config (issuer default or per-security override)

post.summary: Create investor account (omnibus parent or sub-account)
Run omnibus reconciliation snapshot (parent vs Σ(children))

get.description: All dividends for the issuer bound to the API key, newest first.

post.description: Creates the dividend in PENDING_REVIEW. A tZERO transfer-agent reviewer approves or rejects it under a Rule 17Ad-2 SLA timer; status changes are delivered via ta.dividend.* webhooks. Requires an Idempotency-Key header.

get.summary: Get a dividend with payment rollups
Get USDC funding deposit instructions for a CASH dividend
get.description: After a CASH dividend is approved and frozen, returns where and how much USDC to deposit. `requiredBaseUnits` is the ON-CHAIN cash the pool needs — it EXCLUDES holders who elected reinvestment (DRIP, retained by the fund) or off-chain clearing, so it can be less than the declared total. Fund this exact amount to the deposit address; overfunding is held as a refund.

get.summary: Reconcile a dividend: declared vs distributed
get.description: Proves every declared base unit is accounted for across payout modes (USDC paid, reinvested cost, reinvest residual, clearing-settled), with no drift and no open/failed entitlements. `reconciled:true` means the dividend is fully and correctly distributed.

get.summary: List approved payment tokens for a security
get.description: The allowlisted tokens (per the USDC-only policy) accepted as dividendTokenAddress for on-chain CASH dividends on the security's chain and network.

post.description: PENDING_REVIEW: withdrawn before review. DECLARED (not yet executed): cancelled. Executed on-chain dividends must be cancelled by the transfer agent (claim-contract cancellation) — contact tZERO. Requires Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Declare a corporate action (enters tZERO review)
post.description: Creates the action in PENDING_REVIEW under a Rule 17Ad-2 SLA timer. Status changes via ta.corporate_action.* webhooks. Requires Idempotency-Key.
PENDING_REVIEW: withdrawn. ANNOUNCED (not executed): cancelled. Later states are transfer-agent operations. Requires Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Create a voting proposal (enters tZERO review)
post.description: Creates the proposal in PENDING_REVIEW under a Rule 17Ad-2 SLA timer. On approval, voting opens (ON_CHAIN proposals are anchored with their record block + terms hash first). Investors vote in their own portal accounts — votes cannot be submitted through this API. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Get a proposal with running tallies
get.description: Option-level votesCount and sharesVoted update live while voting is OPEN.

get.summary: Get final results with on-chain anchors
get.description: Available once voting has closed and the tally is final (status TALLIED). For ON_CHAIN proposals includes the open/close anchor transaction hashes, the ballots Merkle root, and the canonical tally hash.

post.description: PENDING_REVIEW: withdrawn. OPEN: voting is terminated and the proposal is CANCELLED (ON_CHAIN proposals receive a termination close-anchor). Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of token configurations for the authenticated issuer, each with its on-chain deployments.
Returns a single token configuration (with deployments) owned by the authenticated issuer.
Returns a paginated list of on-chain deployments for the authenticated issuer. Optionally filter by tokenConfigId.
Returns a single deployment owned by the authenticated issuer.
Returns the on-chain operation history (mint, burn, transfer, role changes, …) for a deployment owned by the authenticated issuer.
Returns the custody vaults owned by the authenticated issuer, each with its asset wallets.
Returns a single custody vault (with wallets) owned by the authenticated issuer.
Returns custody transfers across the authenticated issuer's vaults. Optionally filter by vaultId.
Returns the external addresses whitelisted by the authenticated issuer, with their assets.
Returns a single whitelisted address (with assets) owned by the authenticated issuer.
Returns live custody-provider balances for a vault owned by the authenticated issuer. Returns 503 if custody is not configured in this environment.
Lists the assets supported by the custody provider. Returns 503 if custody is not configured in this environment.

post.description: Validates a blockchain address for the given asset via the custody provider. Read-only despite the POST verb. Returns 503 if custody is not configured.

get.description: Estimates the network fee for an asset via the custody provider. Returns 503 if custody is not configured.

post.description: Server-to-server. Issues a short-lived, investor-scoped token for the embeddable plugin. The issuer is taken from the API key; the investor must belong to it.

get.description: Returns the issuer, investor, and scopes carried by the embed-session token.
Securities the embed-session investor may currently subscribe to (ACTIVE link, priced NAV, ALLOW eligibility).

The embed-session investor's bound custodial wallet, on-chain balances, fund URI, and derived buying power. Read-only — never provisions. Pass `securityId` to view the wallet for that security's settlement rail (an EVM security returns its per-chain custody wallet + ERC-20 balance instead of the Stellar wallet).

post.description: Places a held USDC subscription for the embed-session investor and returns deposit instructions.

post.summary: Pay a subscription from custody balance
post.description: App-signed USDC transfer from the investor's custodial wallet to the order's deposit address. Memo-idempotent.

get.description: Live settlement status for one of the embed-session investor's own orders.

post.description: Places a held USDC redemption for the embed-session investor; USDC is paid to their own wallet.
